summary: Golar LNG, via a Form 6-K furnished October 7, 2026 and accompanying press release, disclosed an agreement to acquire the LNG carrier Grace Dahlia from NYK Line for conversion into its fourth floating LNG unit (FLNG #4) ordered August 12, 2026. Terms — price, consideration, and closing date — were not disclosed. The 2013-built vessel has 177,427 cbm capacity, roughly 20% more storage than the 3.5MTPA FLNG Esperanza, and will convert alongside Esperanza at CIMC Raffles Yantai, China, with redelivery scheduled 2029. No advisor or board recommendation named. This is an ordinary asset purchase, not a change of corporate control; watch conversion cost, schedule slippage, charter contracting for FLNG #4, and any capital-raising needs.
